stories.name: Iya Tunde
stories.usedFor: Bought more bags of beans and garri before prices went up
stories.quote: The officer came to my stall and explained everything. No wahala, no shame.

stories.name: Mama Kemi
stories.usedFor: Stocked aso-oke for the festive season
stories.quote: Weekly payment suits my business. I know exactly what I pay.
stories.imageAlt: PLACEHOLDER PHOTO: A woman holding up a folded aso-oke fabric in her shop at Oje Market.

stories.name: Alhaja Fausat
stories.quote: Small-small every day is easy for me. My shop is full now.
stories.imageAlt: PLACEHOLDER PHOTO: An older woman in a gele standing at her provision kiosk with full shelves at Oja'ba.
